scope: Read-only post-hoc examination of the captured ordinary stock-off deck, DAT, imported physical displacement vectors, mesh membership and predeclared oracle; no production implementation, harness or test reads; no native, application, build or solver invocation.

conventions.force_target_derived_from: declared face totals and original face positions, before examining response
conventions.support_action: external support acting on the solid system
conventions.cut_action: action of the excluded side on the specified retained owner

deformable_mesh.mesh_to_deck_connectivity: All 474 elements have the same identities and node memberships. The deck consistently permutes the captured mesh C3D10 ordering by zero-based indices [1,0,2,3,4,6,5,8,7,9], preserving corner/edge associations; raw ordered-list equality is therefore not an appropriate custody check.

actual_CLOAD_resultants.assessment: Actual nodal loads reproduce the declared load wrench to floating-point/printed-coordinate precision. Each half-length side face carries half the declared total. No observed response was used to change a load, sign or denominator.

external_support.boundary: All three translations of reference and all three rotations at rotation node are zero.

physical_support_and_moving_ports.physical_face_membership: All three deck RBE node sets exactly match the corresponding captured selected_face_nodes sets.
physical_support_and_moving_ports.assessment: Both actual finite receiving faces translate X and rotate X. Motion is independently visible in DAT reference outputs and in a six-parameter small-rotation rigid fit to physical imported face nodes, not merely inferred from dummy-node labels.

rotation.equations: Auxiliary U1 equals the corresponding moving RBE rotation-node U1, U2 or U3 with unit coefficient. Auxiliary U2/U3 are fixed; this does not fix the connected physical rotation.

constitutive_motion_diagnostics_from_pri.physical_action_on_A: positive X force and positive X couple
constitutive_motion_diagnostics_from_pri.status: Independent scalar constitutive cross-check only, not a native accounting result.

coarser_imported_face_fit_diagnostic_onl.interpretation: Not an actual native scalar force result. Fitting coarser rounded imported displacements introduces differences smaller than the observed physical-face fit residuals; use the explicit original-node DAT values for the tighter stated precision bound.

separated_reference_transverse_action_ca.qualification_caveat: Opposite transverse SPRING2 forces at separated reference points generally create a nonzero spatial couple and cannot be presumed an objective internal connector wrench pair. This original axial/torsion witness has equal transverse endpoint displacements at DAT precision, with the quantified tiny bound; it does not qualify appreciably loaded noncentral transverse connectors. No fitted correction, sign change, new reference position or changed acceptance scale was applied.

SECTIONFACECUTARIGHT.owner: Solid2, retained A right part x5..10

SECTIONFACECUTBLEFT.owner: Solid3, retained B left part x20..25
SECTIONFACECUTBLEFT.relation_to_predeclared_right_owner_orac: Opposite owner, hence the literal negative of the oracle's B-cut action on retained right. This sign follows the observed geometric owner identity, not a fit to section result values.

ordinary_output_diagnostics_not_native_a.meaning: These ordinary stress-integrated section diagnostics happen to lie within the unchanged 1% ceilings for this small witness. This does not qualify accounting-ON, body/contact/connector accounting, a complete substitute for the requested method, or another fixture.
ordinary_output_diagnostics_not_native_a.raw_RF_warning: Ordinary connector endpoint RF is not an isolated physical connector action: translation RF at A/B is approximately -12/+12 N, opposite the on-body connector action convention; rotation-node RF is approximately 0 and 0.09375 N*mm rather than the physical +/-6 N*mm connector pair. Do not promote these RF values into a qualified accounting wrench.

additional_identity_caveat: The imported result lists 1028 physical nodes plus extra NodeNumbers 1029..1036; these extra IDs cannot be equated with original stock-deck RBE IDs 1033..1038. In particular imported node1033 is not the DAT's fixed external reference displacement and original IDs1037/1038 are absent from the imported list. Auxiliary renumbering is inferred, but no auxiliary mapping is qualified here. Physical nodes1..1028 retain the membership needed for the independent whole-face motion fits; DAT explicitly names the original RBE reference/rotation identities.
conclusion: The stock-off capture faithfully realizes the predeclared separated two-beam axial-plus-torsion witness, with actual face loads, original-origin wrench, cut owners and two truly moving receiving faces. This audit does not examine or repair accounting-on output and does not establish completion of FreeCAD-ywu.
